findings.message: The existing test requires a failed configuration load to remove the selected ticket, but the required live parallel configuration must be read before selection; the test is outside the scope fence.
findings.paved_road: Clarify the intended behavior when configuration loading fails and include this integration test in the scope fence if its expectation should change.
